turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey! How are you feeling?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pretty good so far.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My baby is five months old and my doctor's cleared me to exercise. I feel completely out of shape.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's great news, and be gentle with yourself. A postnatal pilates class rebuilds your core, while a buggy walking group gets you out with the baby. Which appeals more?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey, can you stay quiet for a minute? I need to talk to my partner. I'll come back to you.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Got it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you move my basil off the windowsill?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, it was blocking the blind.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's gone completely floppy now. It was fine yesterday.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's a plant, it'll survive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's on the radiator shelf. It's literally cooking.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Oh. I didn't think about the radiator.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you just put it back where it was next time?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Fine, fine. Sorry, little basil.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace, have you got any cash on you?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Maybe a few coins.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm here again.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. The postnatal plan. Pilates or the walking group?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Different question. I'm getting married next year. How do people pay for weddings without going broke?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Most couples set a total budget first, then decide what matters most to them and spend there.
